**Eligibility Requirements**

Mesa households meeting MesaCAN rent or utility assistance rules. Income, address, documentation and funding apply; utility orientation has an age-60 waiver.

Call Rent appointments 480-750-9228; utility intake 480-833-9200 and ask for the specific service described below. Website: https://turnanewleaf.org/services/financial-empowerment/mesacan/mesacan-rent-and-utility-assistance/

MesaCAN offers rent and utility assistance to low-income City of Mesa residents, subject to eligibility and funds. Applicants eligible for the specific replacement or temporary immigration-status document requested. Forms, fees and possible waivers differ by document.

Call 800-375-5283 for the specific program and current intake. Website: https://www.uscis.gov/contactcenter
